what_this_is: Generation statistics for dataset v0.2-min, and the probe measurements that identified the chat-template defect. Recorded here because the two runs happened on RunPod containers with no persistent volume and the logs were destroyed with them.

provenance.recomputable: per_family_documents is counted from the committed parquet with pyarrow and can be reproduced at any time from data/silver/random and data/silver/mirrors.
provenance.transcribed: Everything under `probes` and the acceptance rates were read from a pod terminal whose logs no longer exist. They are transcription, not artifacts, and are labelled as such for the same reason cuda_latency.json labels its own. Do not cite them as measurements of equal standing with the JSON records in this directory.
provenance.lost: genA.log and genB.log, the full generation logs including per-family rejection breakdowns for the final runs. The first pod was terminated before they were exported. Export logs before terminating a container that has no volume.

the_defect.reading: 2 assistant preambles in 565 attempts is the diagnosis. The validator rejects 'Sure, here is...' openings because a chat model reaches for them, so two in 565 is not an instruction-tuned model resisting the instruction, it is a model that was never in chat mode. 169 empty outputs is what a base-mode continuation of a prompt ending '...do not add any meta commentary.' produces.

after_the_chat_template.reading: Empty went to zero and every assigned document produced one.

qwen_under_the_old_prompt.reading: Rejected for being too SHORT, the opposite direction to the other three families. The prompt asked for a number of 'tokens' while approx_token_count, the extractor's target and the validator's ratio are all word counts, so every model was aiming at a number in a unit nothing measured. Correcting the unit took Qwen from 1,747 accepted documents in the full run to 4,992.

mirror_arm_final_cell.note: The only final-run cell whose summary survives; the rest went with the logs.
